doodle.reason: Captures the energy of building dev tools and the electric flow state of working with Cursor agents

headline: From codebase to roadmap
narrative: Quiet week in Stockholm, heads-down on Cursor tooling. Contributing to cursor-commands while refining Shipflow—point-and-click editing for Next.js. The overcast sky matches the focused energy: building tools that make software development easier and more fun.

sections.title: Cursor tooling
sections.content: Deep focus on cursor-commands and Shipflow. Contributed a PR to the cursor-commands repo, continuing the work on making AI agents feel like natural collaborators. Shipflow—point-and-click editing powered by Cursor Agent—represents the vision: stay in flow, never leave context. 24 commits this week, slightly below typical pace, but the work is surgical and precise.

sections.title: Building in public
sections.content: Recent posts explore the philosophy: surgical moves over sweeping one shots, comparing agents in context, setting vision and letting agents execute. The theme is clear—making building software easier and more fun through thoughtful tooling. Quiet week on X, but the ideas are crystallizing.

sections.title: Dream pop and rap
sections.content: Beach House and Tame Impala providing the atmospheric backdrop, while A$AP Rocky and Fred again.. keep the energy up. Exploring French indie pop with Videoclub—new territory that matches the exploratory coding vibe.

footer: Overcast Stockholm evening, 9°C. Short days, long focus. Building tools in the winter dark.
